description: This file implements internal global meter management for OpenTelemetry SDK, including MeterProvider and Meter delegation, instrument registration, and callback handling.

classes.name: meterProvider
classes.description: A placeholder for a configured SDK MeterProvider that forwards MeterProvider functionality to a delegate.

classes.name: meter
classes.description: A placeholder for a metric.Meter that forwards functionality to a delegate or acts as a no-op.

classes.name: instID
classes.description: Identifies properties of an instrument, including name, description, kind, and unit.

classes.name: delegatedInstrument
classes.description: Interface for instruments that can have their delegate set.

classes.name: registration
classes.description: Represents a callback registration with associated instruments and unregister logic.

classes.name: unwrapObs
classes.description: Wraps a metric.Observer to provide unwrapping of metric.Float64Observable and Int64Observable.

methods.name: setDelegate
methods.description: Configures the meterProvider or meter to delegate all functionality to another provider or meter.

methods.name: Meter
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Meter instance, either delegated or local.

methods.name: Int64Counter
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64Counter instrument.

methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64UpDownCounter instrument.

methods.name: Int64Histogram
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64Histogram instrument.

methods.name: Int64Gauge
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64Gauge instrument.

methods.name: Int64ObservableUpDownCounter
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64ObservableUpDownCounter instrument.

methods.name: Int64ObservableGauge
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an Int64ObservableGauge instrument.

methods.name: Float64Counter

methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Float64UpDownCounter instrument.

methods.name: Float64Histogram

methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Float64ObservableUpDownCounter instrument.

methods.description: Registers a callback function with associated instruments for collection.
